shots.prompt: Wide shot. The woman walks in holding a bowl of salad and announces proudly to the dog: "Starting today, I'm on a diet."
shots.en: Starting today, I'm on a diet.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the Shiba Inu on the sofa, deadpan. The dog says in a deep calm deadpan male voice: "Bold." Then its mouth closes.
Medium shot. The woman sits on the sofa next to the dog, firm and determined: "No more snacks. Not one."
shots.ko: 간식은 이제 끝. 하나도 안 먹어.

shots.prompt: The Shiba Inu silently and slowly turns its head toward a cookie jar on the TV cabinet. Mouth closed. No dialogue.
Close-up of the woman, narrowing her eyes at the dog: "Don't look at the cookies."

Late at night, the living room lit only by the orange floor lamp. The woman tiptoes quietly toward the cookie jar on the TV cabinet. No dialogue. A short upbeat 1990s sitcom slap-bass transition riff plays at the start of this shot, then fades to silence.
Close-up of the Shiba Inu lying on the sofa in the dim light, eyes open, deadpan. The dog says quietly in a deep voice: "Not one, Dana."
The woman freezes with her hand on the cookie jar lid and says nervously: "I was... dusting it."
Close-up of the Shiba Inu, deadpan. The dog says in the same deep voice: "At midnight. With your mouth." Then its mouth closes and a live studio audience bursts into laughter.
Morning sunlight streams through the curtains into the empty living room. No people speak. A short upbeat 1990s sitcom slap-bass transition riff plays.
Next morning, bright daylight. The woman sits on the sofa and points at the dog: "Fine. Then you're on a diet too."
shots.en: Fine. Then you're on a diet too.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the Shiba Inu, ears dropping slightly, deadpan. The dog says in the deep voice: "That's not how love works." Then its mouth closes and the studio audience laughs.
The woman places a single small carrot on the coffee table in front of the dog and says cheerfully: "One carrot. Healthy."
The Shiba Inu stares at the tiny carrot, then slowly looks straight into the camera, mouth closed, silent. No dialogue.
Evening, the floor lamp glows warmly in the empty living room. No people speak. A short upbeat 1990s sitcom slap-bass transition riff plays.
Evening. The woman on the sofa holds a cordless phone, giving in: "Okay. I'll just order one small salad."
shots.en: Okay. I'll just order one small salad.
shots.ko: 알았어. 샐러드 작은 거 하나만 시킬게.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the Shiba Inu, deadpan. The dog says in the deep voice: "Add extra fries. For me." Then its mouth closes.
The woman pauses, then smiles and says into the phone: "...Make it two."

Wide shot. The woman and the dog sit side by side on the sofa looking satisfied, mouths closed. The live studio audience laughs and applauds, then a short upbeat 1990s sitcom slap-bass outro riff plays. No dialogue.
